_key.description: SHA-256 hash of the two Ensembl mouse gene IDs together with the supporting PubMed IDs.

_from.description: Handle of one mouse gene in the genetic interaction.

_to.description: Handle of the other mouse gene in the genetic interaction.

detection_method.description: PSI-MI detection method used to observe the interaction

detection_method_code.description: PSI-MI identifier of the detection method.

interaction_type_code.description: PSI-MI identifiers of the genetic-interaction class.

confidence_value_biogrid.description: BioGRID confidence score from the merged table. Null when the source has none. Larger values mean higher reported confidence.

confidence_value_intact.description: IntAct MIscore from the merged table, on a 0–1 scale. Null when the source has none. Larger values mean more supporting evidence.

source.description: The database, dataset or organization that is a source for these data.

z_score.description: COXPRESdb coexpression z-score: 3 is a false-positive rate of 0.1%, 0 for no value.

name.description: Directional human readable label for the relationship, _from to _to.

inverse_name.description: Reversed directional human readable label for the relationship, _to to _from.

molecular_function.description: Gene Ontology term for protein binding, as a handle into ontology_terms.

method.description: Name of the experimental class or prediction model that produced this result.
enum: dosage rescue (sensu BioGRID), synthetic haploinsufficiency (sensu BioGRID)
negative genetic interaction (sensu BioGRID), synthetic lethality (sensu BioGRID)
phenotypic enhancement (sensu BioGRID), phenotypic suppression (sensu BioGRID)
phenotypic enhancement (sensu BioGRID), phenotypic suppression (sensu BioGRID), synthetic haploinsufficiency (sensu BioGRID)
phenotypic enhancement (sensu BioGRID), phenotypic suppression (sensu BioGRID), synthetic lethality (sensu BioGRID)
phenotypic enhancement (sensu BioGRID), synthetic growth defect (sensu BioGRID)
phenotypic enhancement (sensu BioGRID), synthetic lethality (sensu BioGRID)

label.description: Non-method specific human readable label for the node or edge

class.description: The class of the data this record belongs to: 'observed data' for a direct experimental measurement, 'prediction' for the output of a computational model, and 'biological relationship' for a curated relationship.

files_filesets.description: Reference to the File and Metadata
